schema.photo: IMG_xxxx (must have a GT pose in data/ground-truth.json)
schema.x: px, 1600 basis = image WIDTH 1600 (control-points.json convention; portrait = 1600 x 2133)
schema.lat: WGS84 degrees of the feature (from the map, never from an overlay)
schema.h: optional absolute elevation (m); absent => DEM (Mapterhorn z17) at lat/lon + hAbove
schema.hAbove: optional metres above ground of the clicked point (0 = ground contact)
schema.level: optional { lakeM } for elevation-only waterline pins
schema.kind: shore | waterline | building | junction | bridge | notch | summit | other
schema.split: dev | holdout, copied from the photo's line in PROTOCOL.txt

notes: Peaks, DEM notches and waterlines from data/control-points.json are converted automatically by scripts/concord/lib.ts (controlPointPins) and are NOT duplicated here. Add only blind-clicked interior pins (PROTOCOL.txt section 2).
